items.text: ETR Sunday injury board: OUT includes Saquon Barkley, DeVonta Smith, Lamar Jackson, Breece Hall, Stefon Diggs, Quentin Johnston, Michael Pittman, Pat Bryant, Zach Charbonnet, Jordan Mason; IN includes Jayden Daniels, Chris Olave, Jeremiyah Love, Dallas Goedert.
items.why: Compiled final Friday reports and designations.
items.implication: Multiple high-value outs create clear handcuff/backup and target share shifts; messy Q list for Sunday morning.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries in PHI backfield, LAC WRs (Johnston out), NYJ RBs (Hall out), WAS without Diggs.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) ruled out for Sunday night vs Falcons; Tyler Huntley will start. Additional Ravens outs include Trey Hendrickson and Cam Jurgens.
items.why: Ankle injury; coach Jesse Minter announcement and official ruling after missing practice.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Ravens pass game and rushing upside shift; Flowers remains Q.
items.opportunity: Increased opportunity for Ravens skill players in altered offense; monitor Flowers status.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) ruled out vs Jaguars in London along with DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and others; Tank Bigsby already on IR.
items.why: Hamstring; official Friday injury report and Eagles announcement.
items.implication: Backfield to Will Shipley/Dameon Pierce; Eagles offense depleted in London.
items.opportunity: Clear lead back role for Shipley with Bigsby on IR; receiving work available.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels will start Sunday vs Giants after full practices; WR Stefon Diggs (hamstring) ruled out.
items.why: Full participant all week; official clearance to start.
items.implication: Daniels returns as starter; Diggs absence shifts targets to McLaurin (Q) and others.
items.opportunity: Full QB role restored; short-area targets to TEs/backs or secondary WRs.

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; high workload and soft run defense matchup, with potential Bengals WR injury boost to checkdowns.
items.why: Gobbles targets and fantasy points; volume plus matchup; nickname 'Brown Gobbler'.
items.implication: RB1 upside this week; start with confidence.
items.opportunity: Carries, targets, third-down work; elevated if Chase/Higgins limited.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) full participant, not on final injury report, going full-go. ETR projects him 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier with much bigger workload/role expected this week despite prior usage drag and maintenance.
items.why: Full practice, no designation, player comments full-go; response to Week 4 usage criticism may expand role.
items.implication: Strong RB start with elevated projection; accounts for downside but gut says much better role.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps/routes over Allgeier; goal-line potential vs Lions.

items.text: Chargers ruled out WR Quentin Johnston (among OT Joe Alt, S Derwin James and others) for the week.
items.why: Official team ruling on Friday report.
items.implication: Ladd McConkey and other Chargers WRs see expanded targets/routes.
items.opportunity: Significant target share bump for McConkey and remaining pass-catchers.

items.text: Bears RB D'Andre Swift (hip/knee) has no injury designation for Sunday at GB; Kyle Monangai ruled out.
items.why: Cleared despite earlier misses; Monangai out (thumb/turf toe).
items.implication: Swift sees full/boosted workload as lead back.
items.opportunity: Increased carries, snaps, and goal-line work without Monangai.

items.text: Matthew Berry loves Nico Collins vs Titans, ranking him WR8 on volume including red zone and favorable matchup against a defense struggling vs WRs.
items.why: Target hog with red-zone work; Titans defense vulnerable to receivers.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 play; high floor/ceiling in PPR.
items.opportunity: Heavy target and route share expected.

items.text: Broncos placed WR Pat Bryant on injured reserve and promoted Lil’Jordan Humphrey to the active roster.
items.implication: Short-term IR; opens snaps/targets for Humphrey and remaining Broncos WRs.
items.opportunity: Depth chart elevation for other DEN pass-catchers.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans is off the injury report with no designation for Sunday at Seattle; FB Kyle Juszczyk and DE Nick Bosa ruled out.
items.implication: Evans available in 49ers offense; monitor snap share in new environment.
items.opportunity: Targets available especially with other injuries.

items.text: Levitan flags multi-risk downside for Malik Nabers later this season: knee becoming real issue, lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy at QB, and coaching staff (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman) tendencies; notes Nabers frustration over lack of second-half targets.
items.why: Sore knee missed practice; expressed frustration; structural team risks.
items.implication: Longer-term caution despite talent; monitor weekly availability and target share.

items.text: Berry loves Michael Wilson (WR10 vs DET) on volume/red-zone, Christian Watson (WR15 vs CHI) on matchup/coverage, and Isaiah Likely (TE5 @ WSH) on positional weakness.
items.why: Target volume and specific defensive matchups/weaknesses flagged by Berry.
items.implication: Strong start candidates at WR/TE with upside.
items.opportunity: Routes, targets, red-zone shares elevated relative to ADP/rank.

items.text: Berry hates Jordan Addison (WR41, injury wrinkle + usage), Mark Andrews (TE17), Cam Skattebo (RB20), Tony Pollard (RB28 efficiency/game script), and Jalen Hurts (QB15 rough stretch + line).
items.why: Tough matchups, thin roles, efficiency concerns, injury, or poor recent usage/game environment.
items.implication: Fade or sit in favor of higher-upside options; Andrews especially with Lamar out context.
items.conflict: Lamar OUT may alter Andrews role vs prior hate.
